highlights:
## 🪟 Nod starts reliably on Windows

On some Windows PCs, Nod stopped after two minutes with "Nod's background service did not respond", mostly right after an install or an update. Nod now keeps going while startup makes progress and tells you it can take a few minutes.

Setup also recovers better. If WSL can't start, Nod says so and offers **Install WSL**. A setup that stopped halfway is replaced on the next try, without downloading everything again. If your system drive is too full, select **Choose folder** to keep Nod's private computer on another drive.

If Nod never opened on your PC, download this version and install it over the old one.

## 📋 See every running task in one line

Running tasks now sit next to Nod's status line at the end of the chat, such as "2 tasks running · 1 needs you". Select the line to open a task, read its question or follow its plan. A small chip under Nod's reply shows when a task started, needs you or is done.

## 🔎 Compare results at a glance

Result cards for trains, flights, hotels and products are shorter. Each card shows the key facts and the price. Select **See details** for the rest, or **Check on …** to open the option on its website.

## Also in this release

- **Approvals:** Nod marks the values to check in bold, such as the train, date or amount.
- **Models:** Connect Hostinger AI Router as a model provider. A model that is briefly busy no longer shows a connection warning.
- **Computer use:** Nod reads hidden, minimized, slow and large app windows on Mac and Windows.
- **Downloads:** A download that opens in a popup no longer leaves Nod waiting.
- **Schedules:** Choose each schedule's model on the Scheduled page, which now shows one compact row per schedule. Run history shows the finished reply and shared files.
- **Restarts:** After an interruption, Nod sends one notice and names the task it belongs to.
